title: Cougar Helicopters Inc.
specs: Fleet of modern Sikorsky S92 helicopters with real time position monitoring and flight data monitoring
24/7 dedicated flight following service and Operational Control Centre
SAR crews with military and civilian SAR experience, flight paramedicine, and advanced medical systems
First North American operator to use S92 in SAR role with advanced safety and technical features
State-of-the-art heliport, hangar and dedicated SAR facility with 24/7 365 response posture
Passengers must present a Valid Government Issued Photo ID at Check-in
Passengers who travel offshore Newfoundland will be issued a Survitec Helicopter Passenger Transportation Suit System (HPTSS) and must be properly fitted prior to arriving
Passengers and baggage must comply with security checks via x-ray and metal detectors
Passengers under the influence of alcohol or drugs will not be permitted to board
blurb: Cougar Helicopters operates a fleet of Sikorsky S92 helicopters providing offshore passenger transportation and Search and Rescue services. They maintain a 24/7 operational control centre with flight following and satellite tracking. Their SAR crews have diverse qualifications and extensive experience, and the company emphasizes safety with advanced training and equipment.
extraNote: Check-in for offshore flights commences 1 hour prior to scheduled departure · Customer drug and alcohol policies are in effect at Cougar Helicopters · State-of-the-art heliport and hangar in St. John's, Newfoundland & Labrador
